records.observation: Removed from the Warriors side on Friday due to an ankle injury; expected to be available for week one of the finals.
records.macro_effect: Backline continuity reduced for Round 27; the exact replacement configuration was still being resolved in this observation state.

records.observation: Earlier checkpoint reporting placed Nicoll-Klokstad at centre after Halasima's withdrawal.
records.macro_effect: Retained as an append-only superseded state; final official selection later placed him on the wing.

records.observation: Returns from a hamstring injury and is listed at halfback.
records.macro_effect: Improves first-choice playmaking availability but carries return-from-injury uncertainty.

records.observation: Returns from a hamstring injury and is listed at five-eighth.
records.macro_effect: Restores a preferred halves combination alongside Te Maire Martin, with return-from-injury uncertainty retained.

records.observation: Rested for Round 27; Sam Healey starts at hooker.
records.macro_effect: Deliberate finals-management rotation reduces first-choice spine continuity for this fixture.

records.observation: Rested for Round 27; Eddie Ieremia-Toeava starts in the back row.
records.macro_effect: Reduces experienced edge-forward continuity while preserving Capewell for finals.

records.observation: Moves into the starting fullback role after the Halasima withdrawal triggered a backline reshuffle.
records.macro_effect: Part of the final backline reshuffle; role continuity should be audited post-match.

records.observation: Named at fullback in an unchanged Sea Eagles starting side from the previous round.
records.macro_effect: Maintains Manly's primary attacking threat and starting-side continuity.

records.observation: Returned successfully from injury in Round 26 and remains named at halfback for Round 27.
records.macro_effect: Restores senior halfback leadership and improves Cowboys spine continuity relative to his injury absence.

records.observation: Named to make his NRL debut at halfback, with regular No.7 Ethan Sanders remaining reserve in the Friday 24-hour update.
records.macro_effect: Introduces material halfback inexperience for Canberra and reduces established spine continuity.

records.observation: Named at prop as Canberra prepares to farewell the retiring veteran at season end.
records.macro_effect: Leadership and motivation context noted; no automatic performance uplift inferred.

records.observation: Named in the centres for his 100th Storm appearance.
records.macro_effect: Experienced utility retained in starting backline; milestone noted without assuming performance effect.

records.observation: Named in the centres alongside Tyran Wishart.
records.macro_effect: Part of Melbourne's current centre pairing for Round 27.

records.observation: Named at centre for Cronulla in the Round 27 side.
records.macro_effect: Adds inexperience to a Sharks backline already facing a high-pressure finals preparation match.

records.observation: Named at halfback for Parramatta in Round 27.
records.macro_effect: Maintains senior halfback control in the Eels spine for the current selection state.

records.observation: Named in Penrith's extended squad while nearing return from a pectoral injury; official late mail notes he may be held back until the qualifying final.
records.macro_effect: Return trajectory is positive for finals, but Round 27 participation remains unresolved and must not be treated as confirmed.

records.observation: Final official selection state placed Nicoll-Klokstad on the wing rather than at centre.
records.macro_effect: Corrects the earlier role state while preserving the broader backline-disruption signal.
records.source: NRL Late Mail Round 27 final selection state

records.observation: Final official selection state placed Pompey at centre in the reshuffled Warriors backline.
records.macro_effect: Confirms the final shape of the Halasima-triggered backline reshuffle.
records.source: NRL Late Mail Round 27 final selection state

records.observation: Finished his NRL debut with a record debut points haul of 26 as Canberra defeated North Queensland 50-30; the official live blog also records multiple try assists, towering bombs and repeated goalkicking contribution.
records.macro_effect: Directly contradicts any assumption that debut status alone should materially downgrade Canberra's halfback function. Future rookie-half uncertainty must remain uncertainty rather than automatic negative weighting.
records.source: NRL.com official Super Saturday live blog

records.observation: Passed his opening-minute HIA, returned, scored a try and completed his final NRL game as Canberra won 50-30.
records.macro_effect: Farewell context remains non-causal; performance is recorded as outcome evidence without converting motivation narrative into a predictive rule.
records.source: NRL.com official Super Saturday live blog

records.observation: Sent to the sin bin in the sixth minute for a high tackle during his NRL debut; Storm winger Siulagi Tuimalatu-Brown was stretchered from the field and later reported taken to hospital as a precaution for neck soreness.
records.macro_effect: Cronulla were temporarily reduced to 12 and later 11 players, creating an evidenced early structural disadvantage. No pre-match causal hindsight is assigned.
records.source: NRL.com official Super Saturday live blog

records.observation: Sent to the sin bin in the tenth minute after an open-handed strike to Harry Grant, leaving Cronulla with 11 players while Gabrael remained off.
records.macro_effect: The two-man disadvantage was exploited by Melbourne for the opening try; this is outcome evidence, not retroactive pre-match evidence.
records.source: NRL.com official Super Saturday live blog

records.observation: Received treatment for a leg issue around the 25th minute after defending a grubber; the official live blog reported he returned to his feet with a slight limp.
records.macro_effect: Potential live spine risk only. No diagnosis or expected-duration inference is made.
records.source: NRL.com official Super Saturday live blog

integrity.rule: Player observations remain attributable to source, capture time, fixture and decision effect. Derived player state never destroys prior observations.
